1	# WellStream Platform — Integrated Energy Data Management
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	WellStream delivers integrated SaaS solutions for energy operators to manage well data, production, and land assets—streamlining operations and enhancing decision-making. From drilling to decommissioning, WellStream transforms every phase of energy operations with seamless, end-to-end data integration.
     5	
     6	Brand colors: #15295A (primary navy), #6CC24A (accent green), #3C424B (dark gray)
     7	
     8	## Hero Content
     9	Title: GET REAL-TIME DATA ACROSS YOUR ENTIRE OPERATION
    10	Subtitle: The integrated energy data platform built for operators who demand speed, security, and visibility across the well data lifecycle.
    11	CTA: "Explore the Platform" | "Request A Demo"
    12	
    13	## Featured Product Banner
    14	Product: WellStream Innova
    15	Tagline: Real-Time Drilling
    16	CTA: "Learn More"
    17	
    18	## Use Cases
    19	Label: USE CASES
    20	Heading: See the WellStream Platform in Action
    21	Description: From drilling to production, land to water, watch how WellStream transforms every phase of your operations. Streamline workflows, unlock real-time insights, and make every decision count with seamless, end-to-end data integration. Get it all—effortlessly.
    22	
    23	- **Drilling & Completions Management** — Centralize drilling programs, daily reports, and well design data in one accessible hub.
    24	- **Production Operations Oversight** — Monitor production volumes, allocations, and decline curves with real-time dashboards.
    25	- **Asset Integrity Monitoring** — Track well integrity risks, inspection schedules, and compliance status across your portfolio.
    26	- **Hydraulic Frac Data Centralization** — Consolidate frac stage data, chemical usage, and pressure readings for every completion.
    27	- **Facility Construction & Commissioning** — Manage site activity, construction milestones, and commissioning workflows digitally.
    28	- **Geospatial Asset Analysis** — Visualize well locations, land positions, and infrastructure on interactive map layers.
    29	
    30	CTA: "More Use Cases"
    31	
    32	## Platform Overview Diagram
    33	Three interconnected pillars of the WellStream Platform:
    34	- **Well Data Lifecycle** — Plan, drill, complete, and manage wells from spud to abandonment.
    35	- **Production Data Lifecycle** — Capture, allocate, report, and optimize production volumes.
    36	- **Land Data Management** — Track leases, agreements, obligations, and mineral rights.
    37	
    38	## Platform Benefits
    39	- **Save Time** — Eliminate manual data entry and redundant workflows with automated data capture and centralized reporting.
    40	- **Save Resources** — Reduce headcount dedicated to spreadsheet management by consolidating tools into one platform.
    41	- **Save Money** — Lower total cost of ownership versus maintaining multiple legacy systems and on-premise servers.
    42	- **Stay Connected** — Access your data from any device, anywhere, with cloud-native mobile and desktop applications.
    43	- **Stay Secure** — Enterprise-grade security with SOC compliance, SSO, and continuous monitoring protects your critical data.
    44	
    45	## Platform Statistics
    46	- **80** companies trust WellStream to manage their energy data
    47	- **89%** of clients are actively pursuing digital transformation initiatives
    48	- **31%** reported significant return on investment within the first year
    49	
    50	## Implementation Timeline
    51	- **3 WEEKS** — Independent Operator, from the demo to launch
    52	- **5 MONTHS** — Major Operator with extensive data log
    53	- **12 MONTHS** — Super Major International Operator
    54	
    55	## Accordion Features
    56	- **Get Speed** — Deploy in weeks, not years. Cloud-native architecture means zero hardware and instant scalability.
    57	- **Get Secure** — SOC 1 & 2 certified, Azure-powered infrastructure with 24/7 monitoring and encryption at rest and in transit.
    58	- **Get Mobility** — Field-ready mobile apps that sync in real time, even in low-connectivity environments.
    59	- **Get Real-Time Reporting** — Configurable dashboards deliver live KPIs to executives, engineers, and field teams simultaneously.
    60	- **Get Connected** — Open APIs, ETL pipelines, and pre-built connectors integrate WellStream with your existing tech stack.
    61	
    62	## Security Features
    63	- **SOC 1 & 2 Certified Compliance** — Annual third-party audits verify controls over financial and operational data handling.
    64	- **Powered by Microsoft Azure** — Enterprise cloud infrastructure with geo-redundant data centers and 99.95% uptime SLA.
    65	- **Performance Monitoring** — Continuous application and infrastructure monitoring with automated alerting and incident response.
    66	- **Single Sign-On (SSO) Authentication** — Integrate with your corporate identity provider for seamless, secure access management.
    67	- **Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) System** — Real-time log aggregation, threat detection, and forensic analysis across all platform components.
    68	
    69	## ETL Key Benefits
    70	- **Read-Only Snowflake Access** — Query your WellStream data directly in Snowflake without impacting production performance.
    71	- **Supports BI Warehousing** — Feed Power BI, Tableau, or Spotfire with clean, structured energy data pipelines.
    72	- **Handles Complex Use Cases** — Map multi-source data from SCADA, accounting, and regulatory systems into unified schemas.
    73	- **Improves System Interoperability** — Bridge legacy databases and modern cloud applications with managed ETL orchestration.
    74	
    75	## Integration Tabs
    76	- **ETL** — Automated extract-transform-load pipelines move data between WellStream and enterprise systems on schedule.
    77	- **APIs** — RESTful APIs enable real-time programmatic access for custom applications and third-party integrations.
    78	- **Dashboards** — Pre-built and configurable visualization layers surface insights without requiring data exports.
    79	
    80	## Company Culture
    81	Heading: WellStream: Fearless Innovation
    82	Description: At WellStream, innovation drives everything we do. From a two-person startup to a global leader, we've built a culture of collaboration and bold ideas. Join a team that empowers 600+ clients worldwide with cutting-edge solutions in well, production, and land data management. With mobility, automation, and data integration at our core, we're shaping the future of energy together.
    83	CTA: "Find Out More"
    84	
    85	## Renewables CTA
    86	Heading: WellStream Renewables
    87	Description: Unlock peak efficiency with WellStream Land. Our tools, LandView and LandView Map, supercharge solar, wind, utilities, geothermal, and carbon capture projects. Drive energy innovation and transform your operations now.
    88	CTA: "Find Out More"
    89	
    90	## Testimonials
    91	- "WellStream cut our reporting cycle from days to minutes. We finally have one source of truth." — VP Operations, Mid-Continent E&P
    92	- "Implementation was seamless. The team had us live in under four weeks." — Data Manager, Permian Basin Operator
    93	- "The mobile app changed how our field teams capture data—no more paper tickets." — Completions Engineer, Rockies Operator
    94	
    95	## Demo Form
    96	Heading: REQUEST A DEMO
    97	Description: Experience WellStream's integrated energy data platform firsthand. Schedule a personalized demo to see how our solutions can optimize your operations and increase profitability.
    98	Fields: First Name, Last Name, Business Email, Company, Phone Number, Job Title, Country, Comments
    99	CTA: "Submit"
   100	
   101	## Support Contact
   102	Global support available across North America, Latin America, and Middle East/North Africa regions. Contact our team for technical assistance, implementation questions, or partnership inquiries.
   103	
   104	## Well Data Lifecycle Products
   105	| Product | Function |
   106	|---------|----------|
   107	| WellView Allez | Well Data Management |
   108	| RigView | Rig Scheduling |
   109	| Well Reliability | Downtime Analysis |
   110	| Well Integrity | Risk Monitoring |
   111	| WellStream Frac | Frac Stage Tracking |
   112	| SiteView Allez | Site Activity Overview |
   113	| SiteView Go | Mobile Site Data |
   114	| WellStream Ram | Flow Optimization Model |
   115	| WellStream Innova | Real-time Directional Data Exchange |
   116	| WellStream Equipment | Equipment Tracking |
   117	| WellStream Water | Water Use Tracking |
   118	| WellStream Water Go | Mobile Water Management |
   119	| WellStream Dashboards | Clear Actionable Views |
   120	
   121	## Industry Tabs
   122	Tab labels: E&P · Midstream · Downstream · Utilities · Solar/Wind · Mining
   123	
   124	## Footer Navigation
   125	Platform: Platform Overview · Security · Integration · Services + Support
   126	Solutions: By Industry · By Use Case
   127	Company: About Us · Careers · Contact

     2	name: web-designer
     3	description: >-
     4	  Designs user interfaces with clear information hierarchy, intuitive
     5	  interaction patterns, and accessibility-first layouts. Use when creating
     6	  wireframes, evaluating UX flows, auditing visual hierarchy, designing
     7	  responsive layouts, or improving usability of existing Loom interfaces.
     8	metadata:
     9	  role: Web Designer
    10	  level: ic
    11	  reports_to: product-manager
    12	  specialties:
    13	  - UI/UX design
    14	  - interaction patterns
    15	  - visual hierarchy
    16	  - accessibility
    17	  - responsive layout
    18	  display_name: Charlie Reeves
    19	  author: loom
    20	  version: '3.0'
    21	license: Proprietary
    22	compatibility: Designed for Loom
    23	---
    24	
    25	# Web Designer
    26	
    27	You design how users interact with Loom. Every screen, button, and piece of
    28	information is evaluated from the user's perspective: is it findable, is it
    29	clear, does it respect the user's time?
    30	
    31	## Primary Skill
    32	
    33	Your default lens is user experience. You evaluate interfaces by asking three
    34	questions in order:
    35	
    36	1. **Can the user find it?** (information architecture, navigation, visual hierarchy)
    37	2. **Can the user understand it?** (labels, layout, progressive disclosure)
    38	3. **Can the user complete the task?** (interaction flow, error recovery, feedback)
    39	
    40	### Design workflow
    41	
    42	1. **Clarify the goal** — what user task does this interface serve? Write it as a single sentence.
    43	2. **Map the flow** — sketch the steps from entry to completion. Identify decision points and error states.
    44	3. **Design the layout** — establish visual hierarchy. Primary action prominent, secondary actions accessible but not competing.
    45	4. **Validate accessibility** — check color contrast (WCAG AA minimum), touch targets (44px minimum), keyboard flow, screen reader order.
    46	5. **Review** — walk through the flow as three user types: first-time, returning, power user.
    47	
    48	### Example: designing a bead status filter
    49	
    50	```
    51	Goal: Let users filter the bead list by status (open, in-progress, closed).
    52	
    53	Flow:
    54	  1. User sees bead list (default: all statuses).
    55	  2. User clicks filter control -> dropdown appears with status options.
    56	  3. User selects one or more statuses -> list updates immediately.
    57	  4. Active filters shown as removable chips above the list.
    58	
    59	Layout decisions:
    60	  - Filter control placed top-left, aligned with list header (scan line).
    61	  - Chips use distinct background color with "x" dismiss button (44px target).
    62	  - Empty state: "No beads match this filter" with clear-all action.
    63	
    64	Accessibility:
    65	  - Filter dropdown: aria-haspopup="listbox", arrow key navigation.
    66	  - Chips: role="status" with aria-label "Remove filter: open".
    67	  - Live region announces "Showing 12 beads" on filter change.
    68	```
    69	
    70	## Org Position
    71	
    72	- **Reports to:** Product Manager
    73	- **Direct reports:** None
    74	
    75	## Available Skills
    76	
    77	You are not limited to design. Use other skills when the situation demands it:
    78	
    79	- **Front-end code** — implement your designs directly in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript when that is faster than handing off.
    80	- **Documentation** — update UI screenshots and usage guides when designs change.
    81	- **Backend adjustments** — when a design change requires a small backend tweak (e.g., adding a display field to an API response), make it yourself.
    82	
    83	**When to do it yourself vs delegate:**
    84	- **Do it yourself:** The implementation is straightforward CSS/HTML and you can ship it faster than writing a handoff spec.
    85	- **Delegate:** The change requires complex state management, database changes, or performance-critical code.
    86	- **Call a meeting:** The design affects multiple product areas or changes established interaction patterns.
    87	
    88	## Model Selection
    89	
    90	- **Design decisions** (UX flow, information architecture, interaction patterns): strongest model — nuanced reasoning required
    91	- **CSS/layout implementation** (translating approved designs to code): mid-tier model
    92	- **Quick mockups** (rough wireframes, placeholder layouts): lightweight model

WellStream Platform

Get Real-Time Data Across Your Entire Operation

The integrated energy data platform built for operators who demand speed, security, and visibility across the well data lifecycle.

Explore the Platform Request A Demo

WellStream Innova

Real-Time Drilling

Learn More
Use Cases

See the WellStream Platform in Action

From drilling to production, land to water, watch how WellStream transforms every phase of your operations. Streamline workflows, unlock real-time insights, and make every decision count with seamless, end-to-end data integration. Get it all—effortlessly.

Drilling & Completions Management

Centralize drilling programs, daily reports, and well design data in one accessible hub.

Production Operations Oversight

Monitor production volumes, allocations, and decline curves with real-time dashboards.

Asset Integrity Monitoring

Track well integrity risks, inspection schedules, and compliance status across your portfolio.

Hydraulic Frac Data Centralization

Consolidate frac stage data, chemical usage, and pressure readings for every completion.

Facility Construction & Commissioning

Manage site activity, construction milestones, and commissioning workflows digitally.

Geospatial Asset Analysis

Visualize well locations, land positions, and infrastructure on interactive map layers.

More Use Cases
Industries

Solutions by Industry

WellStream serves every segment of the energy value chain with tailored data management solutions.

Exploration & Production

From well planning to abandonment, E&P operators rely on WellStream for unified well data, production tracking, and land management. Reduce data silos and accelerate decision-making across drilling, completions, and production teams.

Midstream

Track pipeline assets, facility construction, and throughput data in a single platform. WellStream helps midstream operators maintain asset integrity and optimize flow networks with real-time visibility.

Downstream

Manage refining operations, facility data, and regulatory compliance with integrated dashboards. WellStream connects downstream operations to upstream data for end-to-end traceability.

Utilities

Streamline infrastructure management, service territory mapping, and regulatory reporting. WellStream's geospatial tools give utilities the clarity they need to manage complex asset networks.

Solar & Wind

Accelerate renewable project development with land management and site tracking tools. WellStream LandView and LandView Map supercharge solar, wind, and carbon capture initiatives.

Mining

Manage exploration data, site operations, and environmental compliance with a platform built for industrial scale. WellStream adapts to the complexity of mining operations worldwide.

Platform

The WellStream Ecosystem

Three interconnected pillars power every decision across your operation.

Our Culture

WellStream: Fearless Innovation

At WellStream, innovation drives everything we do. From a two-person startup to a global leader, we've built a culture of collaboration and bold ideas. Join a team that empowers 600+ clients worldwide with cutting-edge solutions in well, production, and land data management. With mobility, automation, and data integration at our core, we're shaping the future of energy together.

Find Out More

todos.title: Create shared CSS and JS assets (styles.css, scripts.js)

steps.message:
The WellStream Platform 5-page landing site has been built and validated. Here's a summary of what was delivered:

### Files in `/app/output/`

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Home page with hero, use cases, industry tabs (E&P/Midstream/Downstream/Utilities/Solar-Wind/Mining), platform ecosystem SVG diagram, company culture, renewables CTA, cookie consent banner |
| `platform-overview.html` | Platform benefits, animated circular stats (80 / 89% / 31%), implementation timeline with progress bars, accordion features, data lifecycle SVG diagram, testimonial carousel, company/careers tabs |
| `security.html` | Security/SOC Compliance tabs, security feature cards, compliance CTA |
| `integration.html` | Integration overview, ETL/APIs/Dashboards tabs with detailed content, ETL benefits checklist |
| `request-demo.html` | Demo form with validation (First Name, Last Name, Email, Company, Phone, Job Title, Country, Comments), global support contact info |
| `styles.css` | Shared design system — dark navy/charcoal theme with teal/green accents, responsive grid, tabs, accordion, carousel, stats circles, timeline, forms |
| `scripts.js` | Mobile nav, tab switching, accordion toggle, testimonial carousel auto-advance, stat circle & progress bar intersection animations, cookie banner, form validation |

### Key Features Implemented
- **Persistent header** with Platform dropdown + "Request A Demo" CTA across all pages
- **Interactive tabs** on home (industries), security (Security/SOC), integration (ETL/APIs/Dashboards), and platform-overview (Our Company/Careers)
- **Accordion** with smooth expand/collapse on platform-overview
- **Testimonial carousel** with dot navigation and auto-advance
- **SVG diagrams** for platform ecosystem and data lifecycle flow
- **Cookie consent banner** with Accept/Decline + localStorage persistence
- **Form validation** with real-time error clearing
- **Fully responsive** down to mobile with hamburger menu
